description: This header file declares string formatting utility functions similar to printf, including StringPrintf, StringAppendF, and StringAppendV within the android::base namespace.

methods.name: StringPrintf
methods.description: Returns a std::string formatted according to the given printf-like format and arguments.

methods.name: StringAppendF
methods.description: Appends a printf-like formatted string to the provided std::string* dst.

methods.name: StringAppendV
methods.description: Appends a printf-like formatted string using a va_list to the provided std::string* dst.
